title: Alphonso Davies returns to Canada's men's soccer team vs. Guatemala
summary: Captain Alphonso Davies will be back in the fold when Canada's men's soccer team takes on Guatemala in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals this month.

image.caption: Alphonso Davies of Canada is shown arriving before a FIFA World Cup 2026 match between Canada and Morocco on July 4 in Houston. Davies will return to the Canadian lineup for a match against Guatemala in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals. (Getty Images)

blocks.text: Soccer
Captain Alphonso Davies will be back in the fold when Canada's men's soccer team takes on Guatemala in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals this month.
Bayern Munich defender back on the roster for CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinal
· The Canadian Press
· Posted: Nov 03, 2026 11:37 AM EST | Last Updated: 1 hour ago
The 26-year-old Bayern Munich defender is one of 23 players on the roster unveiled by head coach Jesse Marsch on Tuesday.

Davies played limited minutes for the national team at this summer's World Cup as he recovered from a hamstring injury, and he missed Canada's three friendlies in late September and early October for his honeymoon.
He's played 13 games for Bayern this season, tallying three goals and three assists.
Goalkeeper Maxime Crépeau also rejoins the squad after missing the fall friendlies following the death of his father.

blocks.text: Canada will be without Marseille centre back Derek Cornelius, who was taken to hospital after suffering a hip injury while training with Canada in late September, Celtic right-back Alistair Johnston, who has been dealing with a hamstring injury, and Southampton striker Cyle Larin, who is out with an undisclosed ailment.
Canada, currently ranked 27th in the world, will visit No. 95 Guatemala to open the two-legged series on Nov. 13 before hosting the second leg at Toronto's BMO Field on Nov. 16.

“This is an important window for us," Marsch said in a release. "There's a Nations League Finals place and a Gold Cup spot on the line, and we know how tough it will be to go to Guatemala City and get a result. We want to take care of business there, then come home to BMO Field and finish the job in front of our fans.”
The winner of the series earns a spot in the CONCACAF Nations League Finals in Los Angeles in March 2027 and qualifies for the 2027 CONCACAF Gold Cup.
The loser will play in the Gold Cup preliminary round.

blocks.text: Canada, Mexico, the United States and Panama each earned a bye into the Nations League quarterfinals as the region's top four teams.
Guatemala will make its first quarterfinals appearance in the tournament after winning its group during qualifiers.
The nation's final game in qualifiers – a 1-0 victory over Suriname on Oct. 5 – turned nasty.

CONCACAF said in a release that it handed out punishments to the Guatemalan Football Association for "multiple incidents" during the game, including "discriminatory chants directed at Suriname players by Guatemala supporters, objects thrown onto the field of play, and players’ involvement in a post-match confrontation."
The sanctions include three-game suspensions to players Jonathan Franco and Carlos Estrada for their roles in the confrontation.
Guatemala will also be forced to close 25 per cent of the stadium for its next home CONCACAF Nations League match, and submit a plan for how it will prevent discrimination at future games.
